description: Paginated activity feed (trades, redeems, splits, merges, rebates) for one Polymarket wallet over a period — newest first. Use for "what has this wallet done recently", "show me this wallet's trade history", "did this wallet trade market X". Distinct from polymarket_wallet_positions (current holdings) and polymarket_wallet_performance (aggregated P&L) — this is the raw event-by-event tape. Follow `next_cursor` to page past the current window.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's `next_cursor` — omit for the first page.

end_date.description: ISO date/datetime — only activity at or before this time (default: no upper bound).

start_date.description: ISO date/datetime — only activity at or after this time (default: no lower bound).

type.description: Filter to one activity type, e.g. TRADE, REDEEM, SPLIT, MERGE, MAKER_REBATE (default: all types).

wallet.description: Polymarket proxy wallet address, 0x-prefixed (40 hex chars).

name: polymarket_wallet_activity

data_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when this response was fetched live from Polymarket Data API v2.

title: Polymarket Wallet Activity
